youtube.description:
Kiro sub-agents explained: 4 facts

Four facts about Kiro sub-agents.

1. Built in - There is a context-gathering sub-agent.
2. General purpose - Another handles general tasks.
3. In parallel - They can run side by side.
4. Make your own - Custom agents are supported too.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/custom-agents/subagents/
